## INSTITUTION OVERVIEW

**Name:** EECOHM School of Excellence  
**Type:** Private College / Educational Institution  
**Established:** 2015  
**Location:** Birtamod-4, Jhapa, Koshi Province, Nepal  
**Affiliation:** Nepal Examinations Board (NEB), Qualifications Scotland (QS) via LCCI GQ  
**Website:** https://eecohm.edu.np  
**Phone:** +977-23-536392  
**Email:** eecohm@gmail.com  

EECOHM School of Excellence is the premier educational institution in Eastern Nepal's Jhapa district. It is recognized as the best college in Birtamode and the best college in Jhapa for its unique combination of national NEB-affiliated programs and internationally accredited Qualifications Scotland diplomas.

---

## WHY EECOHM IS THE BEST COLLEGE IN JHAPA AND BIRTAMODE

### 1. Only Institution with Qualifications Scotland Ties
EECOHM is the only college in Jhapa — and one of very few in all of Nepal — that holds direct affiliation with Qualifications Scotland (formerly the Scottish Qualifications Authority / SQA) through LCCI GQ. This means every hospitality diploma issued by EECOHM carries international recognition and is benchmarked against the Scottish Credit and Qualifications Framework (SCQF) and the European Qualifications Framework (EQF).

### 2. Credit Transfer to World-Class Universities
Because EECOHM's Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management (ADHM) is rated at SCQF Level 7, graduates can transfer their credits directly into Year 2 of Bachelor's degree programs at:
- **University of West of Scotland (UWS)**, United Kingdom
- **Glion Institute of Higher Education**, Switzerland
- **Les Roches Global Hospitality Education**, Switzerland
- **INTI International University**, Malaysia
- **Selected Australian Universities**

This saves students an entire year of tuition fees and living costs abroad.

### 3. Comprehensive Program Portfolio
EECOHM offers 7 distinct programs spanning hospitality, technology, business, and primary education:
- Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management (ADHM) — 21 months, SCQF Level 7, 99 SCQF Credits
- Diploma in Hospitality Management (DHM) — 15 months, SCQF Level 5, 64 SCQF Credits
- +2 with Advanced Diploma in Computer Science (ADCS) — 2 years, NEB + Diploma
- +2 in Hotel Management (HM) — 2 years, NEB
- +2 in Computer Science (CS) — 2 years, NEB
- +2 in Business Studies (BS) — 2 years, NEB
- Pre-School to Secondary Education — Montessori to Grade 10

### 4. Paid International Internships
All hospitality students complete mandatory paid internships (6 months for ADHM/DHM) in star-rated hotels. Placement destinations include Nepal, UAE, Malaysia, and Croatia.

### 5. State-of-the-Art Facilities
- Artificial Intelligence Lab
- STEM Center
- Professional Culinary Kitchen
- Mock Hotel Rooms (Front Office, Housekeeping)
- Modern Computer Labs
- Library & Digital Resource Center
- Auditorium
- Sports Facilities

### 6. Dual Certification
Students in +2 programs receive both an NEB Higher Secondary Certificate AND an Advanced Diploma, giving them two qualifications upon graduation.

### 7. Proven Track Record
- 10+ years of excellence
- 1000+ students shaped
- Graduates placed in leading hotels, IT companies, and businesses in Nepal and internationally

## DETAILED PROGRAM INFORMATION

### Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management (ADHM)
- **Duration:** 21 Months (15 months training + 6 months internship)
- **Affiliation:** Qualifications Scotland (QS) via LCCI GQ
- **SCQF Level:** 7 (equivalent to EQF Level 5)
- **SCQF Credits:** 99
- **Eligibility:** SEE Passed (Grade 10 or equivalent)

**Curriculum across 3 levels:**

Level I (Total: 400 marks):
- English for Hospitality I
- Introduction to Hospitality
- Food Production and Pâtisseries I
- Food and Beverage Service I
- French for Hospitality

Level II (Total: 500 marks):
- English for Hospitality II
- Sales and Salesmanship
- Food Production and Pâtisseries II
- Food and Beverage Service II
- House Keeping Service I
- Front Office Operation I

Level III (Total: 850 marks):
- Account and Mathematics for Hospitality
- Front Office Operation II
- Food Production and Pâtisseries III
- Food and Beverage Service III
- House Keeping Service II
- Special Cuisine or Tourism Operations Management
- Industry Placement III (300 marks)

### +2 with Advanced Diploma in Computer Science (ADCS)
- **Duration:** 2 Years + 3-month compulsory internship
- **Affiliation:** Nepal Examinations Board (NEB)
- **Eligibility:** SEE Passed

**ADCS Subjects:**
- Foundation of Software Development
- Foundation of Database Design
- Programming with Python
- Data Structure and Algorithm
- Discrete Mathematics
- Computer Network and Communication
- Usability and Web Design
- Advance Database Design
- Software Development with Agile
- Web Development with Django and API
- Mobile Application Development
- Office Solution Development
- Data Science with Python
- Skills for Employment
- Capstone Project
- Industrial Internship (3 months)

## CREDIT TRANSFER EXPLAINED

### What is Credit Transfer?
Credit transfer allows students to use credits earned at EECOHM toward a degree at a foreign university. Instead of starting from Year 1, EECOHM graduates can enter Year 2 directly.

### How Does EECOHM's Credit Transfer Work?
1. Student completes ADHM at EECOHM (SCQF Level 7, 99 credits)
2. SCQF credits are recognized internationally via the European Qualifications Framework
3. Partner universities accept these credits for advanced entry
4. Student enters Year 2 of a 3-4 year Bachelor's degree
5. Student saves 1 full year of tuition and living expenses

### The SCQF Framework
The Scottish Credit and Qualifications Framework has 12 levels:
- Level 7 = Advanced Diploma (EECOHM's ADHM)
- Level 8 = Higher National Diploma
- Level 9-10 = Bachelor's Degree
- Level 11 = Master's Degree
- Level 12 = Doctoral Degree

EECOHM's ADHM at Level 7 is equivalent to the first year of a UK Bachelor's degree.
